guest_ttl_days.title: Guest list lifetime (days since the last change)

storage.title: Where the browser keeps the guest token
storage.description: local: survives restarts; session: until the tab closes; memory: never stored (the guest list lasts one page view).

consent_category.title: Consent category for storing the guest token
consent_category.description: The token is stored only when the shopper granted this category on the website's consent banner (necessary = always).

merge_strategy.title: On sign-in
merge_strategy.description: into_default: guest items join the customer's default list; keep_lists: guest lists become customer lists (overflow joins the default list).

max_guests_per_ip_per_hour.title: New guest tokens per visitor IP per hour
